name: Dragonhide Mantle
summary: Heavy armor of scaled hide that grants breath-resistant defense and a lashing tail.
description: Shaped from the hide of a creature too old to name, and still radiating a slow warmth. Whoever wears it dreams of flying.

stats.effect: You have a +3 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. You have Resistance to Fire, Cold, and Lightning damage. As a Magic action, you can exhale a 30-foot cone of fire; each creature in that area makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until the next dawn.
